_note: Single source of truth. build_site.py renders every price from here and asserts no price string appears in a template. Platinum carries the recommended badge: Yoni confirmed 18 Aug 2026 that it is the tier most home service providers actually select. Studio scope reflects what is published today, one long-form video a month; a proposal to raise that to two is pending confirmation.

groups.heading: You shoot it
groups.subhead: Everyone on your team already has a phone in their pocket. Our team sends a shot list telling them exactly what to capture, and takes it from there.

groups.heading: Our crew shoots it
groups.subhead: Nobody on your team has to remember to film anything. Having to remember is the reason most content programs quietly die in month three, and removing it is what you are actually paying us to solve.

groups.heading: Studio
groups.subhead: Real production days with a four-person crew, plus long-form video on YouTube. That is a serious amount of capacity, so we only take a few of these at a time. This is closer to having a media department than hiring a vendor. The difference between the two is how much long form you want: one considered YouTube video a month, or one every week.
